name: test_cycle_outcome
description: Deterministic test_cycle decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

outcome.description: The verification executionOutcome to map onto a terminal state, e.g. passed, no_tests_required, code_failed, configuration_blocked, infra_blocked, cancelled. Defaults to 'worker_unavailable' when blank.

candidate.description: The current candidate commit; used to distinguish command_discovery_blocked (a candidate exists) from candidate_commit_missing (it does not).

advanced.description: Whether the last repair attempt advanced the candidate; when outcome is code_failed and this is exactly false, the state is tests_failed_fix_unavailable rather than tests_failed_after_fix_budget.

attempts.description: Total fix attempts made so far; echoed as fixAttempts. Defaults to 0 when not numeric.

runs.description: Total verification runs made so far; echoed as testRunCount only for states where tests actually ran. Defaults to 0 when not numeric.

commandSource.description: Which authority supplied the commands (e.g. user_template, repository_guide); echoed as commandSource, defaulting to 'none' when blank.

verification.description: The last verification result; only its 'commands' array is read.

commands.description: Per-command results, echoed through as the output 'commands'.

testMode.description: The resolved test mode (targeted or full); echoed as testMode, defaulting to 'targeted' when blank.

testCycleState.description: The single terminal state this test cycle mapped to, for the caller to branch on.

testsRan.description: True when testCycleState is one of the three states where tests actually executed.

testsPassed.description: True when testCycleState is tests_passed or no_tests_required.

testRunCount.description: The 'runs' count, but only when testsRan is true; otherwise 0.

commandSource.description: The resolved command source, defaulting to 'none'.

testMode.description: The resolved test mode, defaulting to 'targeted'.

commands.description: Per-command results carried through from the input verification.

testReport.description: Human-readable one-line summary combining testCycleState, testMode, command count, source, run count, and fix attempts.
